activities.name: Hunt with the elders
activities.text: You follow the hunters into the cold grass before dawn.

activities.name: Gather with the clan
activities.text: You learn which roots and berries the land gives in each season.

activities.name: Knap flint
activities.text: You sit at the stone and learn how flint breaks.

activities.name: Tend the fire
activities.text: You keep the clan's fire alive through the long nights.

activities.name: Sit with the healer
activities.text: You learn the herbs, the songs and the quiet of the sick.

activities.name: Listen to the traders
activities.text: You listen as the elders weigh what one thing is worth against another.

activities.name: Wander
activities.text: You go where your feet take you, and see what the land is like.
